mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_closure_request( account_id, destination_general_account_id, early_withdrawal_agreed, status, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{destinationGeneralAccountId}, #{earlyWithdrawalAgreed}, #{status}, #{requestedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_closure_request WHERE closure_request_id = #{closureRequestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account_closure_request SET status = 'COMPLETED', processed_at = #{processedAt}, processed_by = #{processedBy}, withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} WHERE closure_request_id = #{closureRequestId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE account_closure_request SET status = 'REJECTED', processed_at = #{processedAt}, processed_by = #{processedBy}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason} WHERE closure_request_id = #{closureRequestId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_closure_request WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY requested_at ASC, closure_request_id ASC
